purpose: IJHE submission metadata and declarations checklist; do not submit while any confirmation is false.
title: Evidence-grounded safety digital twin and direct-answer decision support for a hydrogen refuelling station
ai_disclosure_statement: During preparation of the working draft, AI-assisted tools were used for code and prose support. The authors must review, edit and take responsibility for all content, references, analyses and claims before submission.
data_availability_statement: Public source identifiers, derived metrics and validation manifests are provided where permitted. Confidential station-side data are not redistributed. No reusable synchronized station-to-vehicle raw trace was identified; this is stated as a limitation.
ethics_statement: No human participants or operator responses are included in the physics validation study. A separate institutional determination and blinded expert study would be required before claiming human safety effectiveness of SAGA.
